steps.action:
# Three Strategies for Reducing Carbon Emissions in Cities

## 1. 🚌 Transform Transportation
- Expand public transit (buses, rail, metro systems)
- Build protected cycling infrastructure
- Transition city fleets to electric vehicles
- Implement congestion pricing to reduce car use

## 2. 🏢 Improve Building Efficiency
- Retrofit existing buildings with better insulation
- Mandate energy-efficient standards for new construction
- Switch heating systems from gas to electric heat pumps
- Install solar panels on rooftops

## 3. 🌳 Shift Energy & Land Use
- Source municipal electricity from renewables
- Expand urban green spaces to absorb CO₂
- Reduce food waste through composting programs
- Support local food systems to cut transport emissions

---

**Key point:** The most effective cities combine all three approaches rather than relying on any single strategy, since transportation, buildings, and energy systems are deeply interconnected.
